name: Sirius Educational Centre
note: Partner of HC Sochi (2026/27 club partners page). The centre's own site says it was created by the 'Talent and Success' educational foundation, founded 24.12.2014 by 'outstanding Russian figures of science, sport and art' on the initiative of President Putin, on the Sirius federal territory. A non-commercial foundation; no nameable owner from open sources — not rated.
